title: BST260 Final Project Proposal
text: project aims apply statistical computational methods introduced BST260 investigate two public health research questions using publicly available datasets. project emphasize reproducible data processing, exploratory data analysis, statistical inference, interpretation uncertainty. Two analyses conducted. first investigate association body mass index (BMI) systolic blood pressure using National Health Nutrition Examination Survey (NHANES). second examine seasonal patterns reported waterborne disease outbreaks United States using CDC outbreak surveillance data. analyses presented two reproducible Quarto vignettes within R package published pkgdown website.
